lines.t: Blessed are those who receive of me.
Blessed are those who eat of the true bread and drink continuously from the fountain of
Blessed are all those in whom I see of myself, for these have already passed from judgment
into life, seated forever at my right hand.
Blessed is the man whose name is written in the book of life, for he shall inherit everlasting
life, and his name shall endure forever.
Blessed are those who have the Spirit of God, for God dwells within them.
blessed be the name of the Lord blessed are all those who receive of his blessings even
more blessed are those who are blessed in the blessing I had sent to them for they are baptized
in the spirit of truth and sprinkled with the blood of sprinkling by which I have blessed all
nations, as many as are willing to receive. Blessed are those who embrace me,
for they shall share in my goodness, even of all that I own.
